implementation: Delegated Work reuses the native Shell Provider and Registry. Each original dispatch stores its process and grant before spawn. Starting and Running require the actual owned process facts.

Model continuation requires a live in-memory owner from the same Work attempt, the original Running observation, the paired Tool Result, and the Evidence registration. The canonical startup marker survives lease loss or a hard exit for reconciliation.

Targeted and duplicate stop use the original handle in the same execution and stream. Unowned task IDs produce a not-dispatched result; they cannot signal another process. Final Work closure drains all of its handles and preserves unresolved effects.

Authority polling is paced from the end of each observation so synchronous storage reads do not repeatedly take precedence over ready model I/O. Revocation stops the owning Work while a response is still being withheld.
